top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 85, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
86ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Belitung's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before February.

Road-specific control matters at GFNY Belitung. Practice on paved volcanic mountain roads with sustained: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 85 miles.
At GFNY Belitung, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Belitung. Train it until it feels boring.
7,316ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 85 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
7,316ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
The aerobic base that lets you ride paved volcanic mountain roads with sustained at tempo for 85 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 85 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Belitung. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

race_overlay.heat: February in Tanjung Pandan, Belitung, Indonesia can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Belitung. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for GFNY Belitung’s 85 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at GFNY Belitung. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at GFNY Belitung rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on paved volcanic mountain roads with sustained climbing to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 85 miles of paved volcanic mountain roads with sustained climbing in Tanjung Pandan, Belitung, Indonesia.
